procedural_matters: The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
Support vessel 109 was represented by Nikitas Kechagioglou.
The international jury was represented by Ulrich Voglmaier.
Mohamed Zanzoul, member of the international jury, attended the hearing as an observer.
HKG 221934 was not protested by the international jury.
facts: After HKG 221934 finished racing on 16 April 2025, support vessel 109, driven by Nikitas Kechagioglou, towed HKG 221934 from race area B to approximately 100 metres outside the harbour.
HKG 221934 was towed at a speed greater than 5 knots.
HKG 221934 was not in danger, the boat was not damaged and the crew was not injured.
The race committee did not display flag T.
conclusions: By towing a boat when flag T had not been displayed support person Nikitas Kechagioglou, of support vessel 109, failed to comply with the Support Vessel Regulations 1.11 and therefore broke Notice of Race 18.5.
decision: Using the World Sailing Discretionary Penalty Policy for support persons, a starting penalty band of Level 1 was decided. Support person vessel 109 (Nikitas Kechagioglou) is warned not to break a rule of the Support Vessel Regulations again. HKG 221934 was warned under RRS 62.4 that a penalty may be imposed on HKG 221934 if Nikitas Kechagioglou commits a further breach of any rule.
